name: Community Room
description: A Host-authoritative multi-member chat room over independent Leader-to-Member P2P channels. Messages receive a single global order, late join is supported, and public checkpoints allow exact Leader failover.

rules.authority: The current Leader validates text bounds and assigns every accepted message one global sequence. Members never accept messages directly from other Members.
rules.membership: The room accepts 2-32 registered Members and permits late join. Stable seats survive reconnect and Leader changes.
rules.recovery: The room has no private protocol state, so every Member retains an exact recovery checkpoint. A new Leader resumes the same timeline and appends a Leader-change system notice.
rules.content_boundary: Chat text is relayed and rendered as data. The protocol does not concatenate peer text into an LLM prompt.
